title: Microsoft Windows Active Directory - Domain Trusts
description: Domain-level trust relationships that extend authentication and authorization between Active Directory domains. This component is instantiated per domain trust and explicitly models trust direction and security characteristics.

implemented-requirements.description: Domain trusts enforce controlled information flow between domains. Trust direction explicitly constrains authentication and authorization transitivity.
Authentication across domain trusts is constrained to Kerberos-based mechanisms and restricts unauthorized credential propagation.
Domain trust relationships are treated as boundary extensions requiring compensating controls such as SID filtering and restricted transitivity.
